id: title:TueHaulund:generate search suggestions up front for every scanner and team

review.posthog_relevance: Adds team-specific database models and configuration parameters for search suggestion generation, including watermark filtering and candidate selection, though complete workflow and test implementations are missing.
review.reason: The chunk adds a TeamReplayVisionConfig model and migration, configuration constants, and a watermark filter implementation, establishing the database and parameter layer for search suggestions. However, it lacks the complete workflow, scheduling, and test implementations, and P1.F16.H4 is restricted to tests. This represents a foundational, localized maintenance and setup change.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of database and configuration changes, but the absence of complete workflow and test implementations prevents a higher tier. The benefit is not demonstrated, only the setup is established.
